# Mobile simulation interaction

Portable components only. Keep the supplied cream/amber tokens and system fonts. No wordmark, marketing heading, duration label, redundant scene taxonomy, or explanatory footer in the interaction.

Portrait block: immersive activity stage with a compact speed arc and exit in its safe top margin. The prompt, countdown, choices, and results are compact panels inside the stage. The renderer resizes into the unobscured area above each panel. Start/Continue/Retry remain below the stage. The gauge shows relative illustrative speed, not calibrated mph. Target 360×800 and 390×844 without decision scrolling. Host may set --scenario-height for an embedded viewport.

Required timed challenge: full-speed approach, continuous 8% speed decision moment, then full-speed consequence. No discontinuity when an action is selected. Wrong actions and timeout show a non-graphic spiky impact/near-miss marker and direct scenario-specific feedback. Reduced motion omits shake and uses restrained discrete motion; timer remains readable. Correct results provide Continue only, incorrect results Retry only.

Loading and ready states must show real scene imagery. Retain useful 3D corner captions and rear mirror, clear blind-spot highlight, and safe/unsafe result distinction. Scene geometry and people remain stylized; no graphic injuries.
